label: One power: all active powers of y are one (OnePower), the power-level aspect of simplicity
definition: OnePower A y: for all p and q, if PowerOf y p and PowerOf y q then p = q.
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred (docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md). ST I q.19 a.4 ad 4 (read in the materialized witness of passage 74e86e1a, navigation, no claim): knowledge directing, will commanding and power executing, 'Sed haec omnia in Deo unum sunt'. Example: on Aquinas's account, God. Non-example: a human, whose intellect, will and nutritive powers differ; the intellectual-chancer model, a necessary being with a rational and a non-rational power. Not implied by an invariant set-up.
